content: ASP.NET Core 10: ForwardedHeadersOptions.KnownNetworks + Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpOverrides.IPNetwork obsolete (ASPDEPR005); use KnownIPNetworks with System.Net.IPNetwork. Default trusts loopback only, ForwardLimit=1 processes rightmost X-Forwarded-For entry; two hops (Traefik->nginx->api) need ForwardLimit=2 and both proxies' network trusted. RC1 bug dotnet/aspnetcore#63627 (KnownIPNetworks.Clear) fixed via PR #63658.
